result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, with the partially clipped carousel items and bottom-of-screen card treated as normal scrolling behavior. The main visual defect is the bottom navigation area, where stray overlay icons and a dark line sit on top of the nav bar, and the nav bar itself appears slightly clipped at the screen edge. A minor copy-styling issue also affects the promo code legibility.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps with a browser-like overlay consisting of a dark horizontal line and small gray icons (magnifying glass, bookmark) that appear on top of the nav icons, making the bar look cluttered and misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Remove the overlapping overlay elements or ensure they are rendered behind/below the app's bottom navigation bar so the home, search, receipts, and profile icons display cleanly.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is visually cut off at the bottom of the screen, leaving the nav icons partially clipped and inconsistent spacing compared with the rest of the interface.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area padding so the navigation bar and its icons are fully visible above the screen edge.

issues.description: The promo code text reads "Use code TALLINN3" with an ambiguous space/word break that could be misread as "TALL INN3".
issues.suggestion: Display the code in a distinct style (e.g., bold, monospace, or a highlighted chip) to make the exact code string clear.
